source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Criteria requires `udfi`, which is not a defined boot type, while historical reviews and the apparent intent interpret it as UEFI. The Master token is preserved and needs an approved Review-layer correction before acceptance can be deterministic.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only command and boot-mode purpose are clear. The typo and platform decoder are supplyable engineering inputs, so static review and eventual automation are not intrinsically blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2247 Wistron-BMC Sanity-00029-V001: confirm whether literal Criteria `udfi` is an approved typo for UEFI or another value; approve the SUT/BMC/BIOS/OS boot policy and exact `ipmitool chassis bootparam get 5` formatted/raw flag decoder including valid, persistent/one-time and EFI fields; define acceptable OS-side corroboration, secure target path and mismatch handling.

review_improvement: Preserves the exact source command while making both the undefined acceptance token and selector-5 semantics explicit instead of silently passing on a guessed text correction.
independent_technical_reasoning: The IPMI query is safe and machine-readable, but selector 5 carries multiple boot flags whose current validity and persistence matter. A displayed EFI indicator can describe the next boot override rather than prove how the running OS booted. The literal Criteria value is not a recognized boot mode and therefore must be treated as a source conflict, even though UEFI is the likely intent. Once engineering approves the correction and decoder, the comparison needs no manual action.
